title: Chickadee outsmarts an indoor cat who thought she had the perfect ambush
description:
Kathy shared this clip of a cat who decided that a backyard chickadee was going to be her lunch.

"Storm is one of my indoor cats," she told WooGlobe.

"She loves to chill out with us in our enclosed backyard in the summer months."

Storm spotted the fluttery guest, narrowed her eyes, crouched into full stealth mode, and waited for destiny to call.

This clip shows her going to try and catch this little chickadee, but it didn't end in her favor.

The leap was dramatic, the timing was right, but the outcome was tragically wrong
